LUA_GAME_comment: Racing force feedback profile. Sega Rally drive board: two 32-step force bands (0xC0-0xDF from the right, 0x80-0x9F from the left). Emitted values follow the standardized MSOP FFB vocabulary. Not yet hardware-validated.

FFB.SOURCES_comment: Native output name candidates, probed in order at runtime; the first name the running machine actually created wins (logged to the MSOP debug console). Replace with a 0x-prefixed emulated RAM address if the driver exposes no suitable output on your MAME build.
